scenes.title: Introduction
scenes.text: Rockets allow spacecraft to escape Earth's gravity and reach orbit.

scenes.title: Newton's Third Law
scenes.text: Expelling gas downward pushes the rocket upward.

scenes.title: Orbital Velocity
scenes.text: Objects must reach 7.8 km/s to stay in Low Earth Orbit.

scenes.title: Rocket Staging
scenes.text: Rockets drop empty fuel tanks to reduce mass.
